name: EPIC 211527719
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 9.9 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 211527719 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.889047 (16th-84th percentiles 9.510522-10.211608), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 6,585 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.93 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,859 K at its surface.
